style_source: Ginkgo runs/refset_0924 (W038-W041), gwlib worldpack, lite textures
units: metres in Blender; FBX exported like the W038 delivery (FBX_SCALE_UNITS) -> Unreal centimetres at import scale 1 with Convert Scene + Convert Scene Unit on
axes: +X east, +Y north, Z up; street (front) face is -Y; origin = footprint centre at street level (bridges: deck top at Z=0; street tiles: road top at Z=0)

groups.Structure: solid, give it collision (complex-as-simple recommended for stairs/landings)
groups.Glass: glazing only (sits flush on a solid core; collision optional)
groups.Signs: decals, lightboxes, neon, cable lights: NO collision
